units.source_text: 她自言自语地吟唱，把身子躲在柱后，借以隐藏脸上的泪痕。

en.t: She murmured the song to herself and hid behind a pillar, trying to conceal the tear stains on her face.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看见她的样子异常可爱，觉得平生所见无数美人，没有一个比得上她。

en.t: Prince Genji saw how extraordinarily lovely she looked, and felt that none of the countless beautiful women he had ever seen could compare with her.
